name: Claude Code v2.1.287
hook: October 1 release ships Claude Mods — a new extension point letting plugins modify Claude's deeper behavior at runtime (not just slash commands and hooks). The built-in 'you should know' mod adds a side agent that watches your session and flags things you or Claude might miss; enable it with `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin`. Also fixes a long-standing safety gap: dangerous `rm` commands with `~` or wildcard paths were silently losing their safeguards. MCP improvements add URL-prompt support for OAuth sign-in flows, and Remote Control gains a built-in `gh api` (REST) for Anthropic-managed git sessions.

name: Claude Opus 5.5
hook: Released September 22, but Reddit lit up this week: 'Claude is BACK!' hit 1,575 upvotes on r/ClaudeAI as developers reported Opus 5.5 communication quality is 'an order of magnitude better' than Opus 5. Benchmarks: matches Fable 5.1 on most tasks, runs 40% cheaper than Opus 5, 30% faster, 1M-token context window, $4/$20 per MTok. Fast mode in Claude Code delivers 2.5× speed. Anthropic's highest behavioral audit score to date. A complex coding task that took 38 prompts over four days with Opus 5 completed in 11 prompts over three hours with Opus 5.5.

name: ECC
hook: The agent harness OS sitting at #1 on GitHub's claude-code topic with 271k stars. ECC wraps Claude Code (and Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and 8 others) with a complete software-development lifecycle: 293 reusable skills covering TDD, security, frontend/backend, and domain work; 68 specialized agents for planning, architecture, build repair, and code review; 94 workflow commands; AgentShield security scanning for prompts, config, and permissions; and session-persistent memory. v2.2.3 shipped in October 2026. The ethos: plan → test → implement → review → verify → remember → improve.

name: Graphify
hook: Type `/graphify .` in Claude Code and it transforms your entire codebase — plus docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph in seconds. Local deterministic AST parsing via tree-sitter (37 languages, no LLM call) handles code; semantic analysis handles docs. Outputs graph.html (interactive click-through visualization), GRAPH_REPORT.md (key concepts and surprising connections), and graph.json (queryable data). An MCP server mode makes it work for repeated programmatic access. Community detection uses the Leiden algorithm; edges are tagged EXTRACTED vs INFERRED. 123k stars.
install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install

name: agent-skills (Addy Osmani)
hook: Production-grade engineering skills by Addy Osmani (Google Chrome DevTools lead, 'Learning Patterns' author). 25 skills that encode the discipline separating production code from prototypes — Google's engineering culture baked in: Hyrum's Law, the test pyramid, trunk-based development, and Zero Tolerance Flakiness for tests. Nine lifecycle slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /security-audit, /perf-audit, /ship, /skills) map to the full development lifecycle. Four agent personas (code-reviewer, test-engineer, security-auditor, web-performance-auditor) for delegated work. 100k stars.

name: Ponytail
hook: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. Ships a six-step YAGNI decision ladder that fires before every code change: does this need to exist, is it already in the codebase, standard library, platform, or installed deps, can it be one line? Only then: write minimum viable. Six slash commands, support for 10+ agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. JetBrains benchmarked 15% output reduction across 80 tasks; Chase AI's testing showed up to 50% code cuts and 53% Opus cost drop. 150.1k stars.

name: Caveman
hook: why use many token when few token do trick. A skill + proxy for 30+ coding agents that forces responses into compressed caveman-speak while preserving code, commands, and exact error messages verbatim. Started as a Friday joke in April 2026, hit #1 on Hacker News with 904 points and 366 comments, #8 Product of the Day on Product Hunt, and now sits at 109k stars. JetBrains tested 86 real Claude Code tasks: 8.5% fewer output tokens with no detectable quality change. The cavemem persistent memory module (same author) is merged into the main repo.

name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
hook: v2.0's Design System Generator analyzes project requirements and produces a complete tailored design system in seconds — 192 industry-specific reasoning rules, 79 searchable UI styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 25 chart types, 16 tech stacks. 131.9k stars on GitHub, 347k+ installs in the Skillselion catalog. Chase AI dedicated a full video to the v2.0 upgrade, calling it the must-have design skill.

name: OpenRig
hook: Multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code and Codex together as one system — define your agent team in a YAML file, boot it with one command. Agents message each other directly over tmux and queue work between themselves; teams and agents are snapshotted and restored as YAML. Requires Node.js 22+ and tmux on macOS or Linux. Hit 4k stars with +733 in its debut day on GitHub trending.

name: coucou
hook: A tiny friend that lives in your Mac's notch — or at the top of your screen on Windows — and keeps an eye on your Claude Code sessions. See every session's reads, edits, and runs step by step; permission requests show up with Allow/Deny buttons for one-click approval; built-in chat straight from the notch. Integrations with Stripe, n8n, GitHub, Vercel, Resend, Notion, and Cal.com each get their own colored Mochi. macOS 15+ (Swift 6) and Windows 10/11 (Tauri 2). 2.2k stars.

name: CLI-Anything
hook: Makes any software agent-native by auto-generating a production-grade CLI for it via a 7-phase pipeline: source analysis, command architecture, Click implementation, test planning, documentation, and package publishing. The generated CLIs output JSON, support REPL mode, and include undo/redo. Install the Claude Code plugin and run `/cli-anything ./gimp` to make GIMP fully controllable by Claude — same for Blender, LibreOffice, and 50+ other apps. 51.1k stars.

name: Claude for Financial Services
hook: Official Anthropic reference implementation of Claude agents, skills, and data connectors for financial services. Covers investment banking (pitch decks, LBO models), equity research, private equity (sourcing to IC memos), fund administration (GL reconciliation), and wealth management (rebalancing, compliance). Ships 11 named agents, 6 vertical skill bundles, and 11 MCP integrations including FactSet, S&P Global, PitchBook, and Morningstar. 38.3k stars.

name: security-audit-skill (Cloudflare)
hook: Official Cloudflare security audit skill for coding agents. Runs a 6-phase process: reconnaissance, coverage-led vulnerability hunting, candidate validation, structured output generation, independent verification, and target-neutral reporting. Covers memory safety, prompt injection, LLM-specific attacks, web protocol flaws, supply chain issues, cloud IAM misconfigs, and more. 23.4k stars.

name: Claude Code Best Practice
hook: The 'vibe coding to agentic engineering' reference guide. Distills 176 tips from 17 high-starred repositories (500k+ combined stars) and an 83-item tricks collection sourced from Boris Cherny (Claude Code's creator at Anthropic) and Thariq. Covers agents, commands, skills, hooks, workflows, MCP servers, plugins, and memory. 66.8k stars and still climbing.

name: ARIS (Auto-Research-In-Sleep)
hook: Claude Code skills for autonomous ML research while you sleep. A single `/research-pipeline` chains idea discovery → auto review → paper writing; `/experiment-queue` manages multi-seed/multi-config SSH job queues with OOM-aware retry. v0.4.28 adds reasoning effort support (ARIS_REASONING_EFFORT=low/medium/high/xhigh/max), anti-hallucination citation verification via DBLP/CrossRef, and Codex CLI 0.154 bridge. 83 bundled skills. Purely Markdown — no framework, no Docker. 16.9k stars.
